description: Cues close in character to a given one — matched on the catalogue's own editorial description of each cue together with its genres, moods and instrumentation — for 'more like this one' moments. It compares how the cues are DESCRIBED, not the waveforms, so it is strong on character and mood and will not hear two cues as alike purely because they sound alike. Give the user each result's listen_url. Results are main mixes from other cue families, at most three per album.

limit.description: How many similar cues to return (default 8).
limit.title: Limit

ref.description: The track ref to match against.
ref.title: Ref

name: stye_find_similar
